_comment: Single experiment config for the QDMC rare event sampling pipeline. Paper-faithful defaults (N=400 walkers, M=100 AI members, 37 total days). For a quick smoke test, override on the CLI: `python run.py airres --walkers 4 --members 2`. The default AI+RES scheme is 'ck' (C_schedule_ck); other schedules below are exploratory alternatives. NOTE: the report (section 3.2) states the surface-pressure perturbation amplitude as sqrt(2)*1e-4; this config uses perturbation_magnitude=0.003 as actually run -- see README.

nw_box.label: Northwest Box 3x3 (Aquaplanet Coordinates)
nw_box.display_bounds: 26.5N-32.1N, 70.3E-75.9E box on aquaplanet grid (northwest-India analog target)
